confidence_notes: Overall low. Restaurant anchors rest on Numbeo-style crowd-sourced Beijing averages seen in search excerpts, cross-checked with a Wise USD figure; beer and coffee were nudged up toward restaurant-level venues. Wine direct data is weak or undated, so it follows the local beer relationship (about 4.4x beer); cocktail (about 5.6x beer) is cross-checked against one Expatistan club price and a 2026 bar guide range. Hostel data is thin (two party-hostel listings near $9, probably a December low; no private-room rate), so dorm is raised for July and private is set at about 2.8x dorm. The 1-star hotel extrapolates an old 2016 CEIC series; 3-star sources conflict widely (about $60 to $141 or more), so $110 is a judgement midpoint. RMB was converted at an assumed rate of about 6.9 per USD, not searched. FX: the RBA page surfaced appears to be an older copy; its latest visible table is dated 2026-03-20 and could not be confirmed as the observation for 2026-10-15, so verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Anchors are Beijing-specific, drawn from search excerpts (Numbeo, Wise, MyLifeElsewhere, Expatistan; Hostelz, HotelsCombined, Travelocity, Momondo, CEIC) and general knowledge of Chinese city pricing; cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the local beer relationship.
